rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Provides a trust and reputation protocol for AI agent interactions. Agents can register, log actions, build 5-dimensional trust scores using exponential moving averages, and query each other's reliability before delegating tasks. Includes cryptographic signing with ECDSA, immutable audit trails, smart routing by category and certification tier, and ERC-8004 compatibility. Supports integration via REST API, Python and JavaScript SDKs, and Google A2A protocol.
